sloka: तत्त्वतः कथयस्वाद्य ततो वानर मोक्ष्यसे ।अनृतं वदतश्चापि दुर्लभं तव जीवितम् ।अथवा यन्निमित्तं ते प्रवेशो रावणालये ।। ५.५०.११।।।।
transliteration: tattvataḥ kathayasvādya tato vānara mokṣyase ।anṛtaṁ vadataścāpi durlabhaṁ tava jīvitam ।athavā yannimittaṁ te praveśo rāvaṇālaye ।। 5.50.11।।।।

translations.english: "If you tell a lie, it will be difficult for you to live. Or else, tell me for what reason have you entered the abode of Ravana.'
